name: Real Estate Deal Scorecard
tagline: Grades a US property across six rental and flip strategies before you get attached
description: Hand it a US street address or a listing page and it scores the deal six ways: rooms let individually, leases of months or years, nightly stays, a renovation resale, and a buy-fix-refinance-rent cycle. Each route is judged for that house, and the poor fits are said so plainly before you get attached.
author: TZitsnotjustAI
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
